column4: the Einstein-Lovelock tensors of a spacetime with two scale factors, computed from the pair curvatures K_(4i) = H_i' + H_i^2, K_(ij) = H_i H_j by E^(k)m_m = (-1)^(k+1) k! 2^(k-1) times the sum over the sets of 2k directions other than m of the sum over their divisions into pairs of the product of the pair curvatures: for 3 + 4 directions (the cosmological spacetime of the author's document KOHN_SHAM_GRAVITY) the nine components E^(1), E^(2), E^(3) (time, ordinary space, auxiliary space), each with its coefficients of H_a' and H_b', equal the 21 polynomials printed in that document at four pairs of rates (largest deviation 2.6e-15)

the self-consistent evolution of the author's document is reproduced: with his data (kappa = 1000, LambdaBar = 0, H_a(0) = 0.05, a(0) = b(0) = 1, Kohn-Sham matter of the saturation density) the constraint gives H_b(0), and the integration to x4 = 20 gives a, b, H_a, H_b; for Einstein gravity and for Einstein-Lovelock gravity with alpha_2 = 20, alpha_3 = 500 the ten numbers agree with the printed ones to 4.8e-8 (relative); the constraint is preserved to 1.3e-14. The conservation law eps' + 3 H_a (eps + p_a) + 4 H_b (eps + p_b) = 0 holds at the test point of the document (a = 1 + 0.3 x + 0.05 x^2, b = 1/(1 + 0.2 x), x = 0.7) with the relative residual -9.2e-10

the deflating spacetime in the author's Einstein-Lovelock gravity (four flat coordinates x0..x3 with H_a = 0, three deflating coordinates with equal rates, H_b = -g55): (i) it solves the three field equations without matter for LambdaBar = 3 g55^2 and alpha_2 = 1/(4 g55^2) (residuals 5.4e-16 g55^2; alpha_3 is arbitrary because E^(3) vanishes), in agreement with the exact checks 44d-G10 and 71d-G10; (ii) at this solution the two equations for the accelerations are -6 H_a' + .. and +2 H_b' + .. (deviation of the matrix of coefficients from diag(-6, 2): 2.2e-15): the evolution is well defined; (iii) in Einstein gravity without the Gauss-Bonnet term and without LambdaBar the same spacetime needs a source with kappa eps = 3.0 g55^2, kappa p_a = -6.0 g55^2, kappa p_b = -3.0 g55^2, that is p_a = -2 eps along the flat coordinates and p_b = -eps along the deflating ones. Kohn-Sham matter cannot be this source: its pressure along a coordinate on which the fields do not depend is Pi = (1/2) G_V rho^2 + (M - m)^2/(2 G_S), and Pi = -eps would require e_kin + G_V rho^2 = 0

the matter of the two forms of the 4+4 model as a source of gravity (fields that do not depend on x5, x6, x7, D = 4; couplings of the Lagrangian g_0 = -g, g_1 = +0.1 g; state of lowest energy per particle over all densities and polarizations, module halves). covariant form (the definition): threshold g m^3 = 332.2917; at three times that strength the saturated state has one half filled (Fermi momentum of the filled states 0.52859 m, mass 0.37920 m, E/N - m = -0.09072 m, eps = 8.990698e-4 m^5, interaction pressure Pi = -7.826926e-5 m^5); as matter of one kind: 4 states, G_S = -934.5703, G_V = 261.6797. quantized-sector form (the alternative): threshold g m^3 = 121.0858; at three times that strength the saturated state has equal halves (Fermi momentum of the filled states 0.58171 m, mass 0.35844 m, E/N - m = -0.10601 m, eps = 2.592903e-3 m^5, interaction pressure Pi = -2.681363e-4 m^5); as matter of one kind: 8 states, G_S = -358.7168, G_V = 72.6515. The same states computed by the Kohn-Sham routines for matter of one kind of particle (module kohn_sham, other integrals) agree in mass, energy density, pressure and interaction pressure to 1.3e-15. In an evolution without collisions every particle keeps its state, so that a half that is empty stays empty: the source is then matter of one kind of particle throughout

the deflating vacuum solution of the tuned Einstein-Lovelock gravity, perturbed without matter. Near the solution the constraint reads -6 g55 dH_b - 48 H_a^2 = kappa eps (to lowest order; dH_b = H_b + g55): (a) for a deflation that is SLOWER than g55 there are no initial data without matter near the solution (no root H_a between -g55 and +g55 for H_b = -0.999 g55; the constraint is a polynomial of degree four in H_a whose roots for H_b = -g55 are 0, 0 and (6 +- sqrt(20)) g55, the two last ones far from the deflating solution); (b) for H_b = -1.001 g55 the constraint has the two roots H_a = +-g55 sqrt(0.001/8) = +-0.01118 g55 to lowest order (found to 4 per cent), and in both cases the deflation does not return to the rate g55 but becomes faster and faster: H_a(0) = +0.01147 g55: at tau_ref = 6.00, H_a = +1.73339 g55, H_b = -6.42224 g55; H_a(0) = -0.01088 g55: the rates run away; at tau_ref = 5.20, H_a = -0.00498 g55, H_b = -50.15518 g55. The exactly exponential deflation is therefore an UNSTABLE solution of the gravity in which it is a vacuum solution: it lies on the edge of the allowed initial data, and every allowed perturbation, with or without matter, grows. Constraint preserved to 8.3e-9
